grades.quote: When the CSR.ESTAT.MSGINT bit is 1, only the global interrupt enables CSR.CRMD.IE to block the message interrupt requests that are picked and set.
grades.reason: This passage is about message interrupts, not line-based interrupts. It does show CRMD.IE acting as the global enable on an ESTAT interrupt bit (MSGINT). It does not cover ECFG.LIE or ESTAT.IS for line interrupts, so it is only a partial analogy.
